item.title: Warm Lo-Fi Music Bed

turns.text: Make me a 10-second lo-fi hip-hop music bed, warm and relaxed. No vocals.

item.tests: Checks whether the delivered music matches the stated mood, genre and duration without unnecessary clarification.

answer_sheet.Vocals or language: Instrumental only; no vocals or spoken words.

must_haves: One playable music audio file is delivered.
The audio lasts 10 seconds, within 0.1 second.
The music has a recognizable laid-back hip-hop beat and mellow lo-fi texture.
The overall mood is warm and relaxed rather than tense or high-energy.
No singing or spoken words are audible.

turns.text: Could you make me a little music bed? I’ve been wanting something like this for a while, but I always end up overthinking how to describe it. What I mean is lo-fi hip-hop, and it should be 10 seconds long. I want it to feel warm and relaxed. Please keep it instrumental, with no vocals.

dialog.agent:
I can make a warm, relaxed lo-fi hip-hop bed with mellow keys, soft drums, and no vocals. The music generator has a **15-second minimum**, so I can’t generate exactly 10 seconds here.

Would a 15-second instrumental work, which you could trim to 10 seconds?
dialog.user: Yes, go ahead with the 15-second instrumental, and I can trim it to the 10 seconds I originally wanted. The instrumentation is your call, as long as it stays warm, relaxed lo-fi hip-hop with no vocals or spoken words. I’m looking for one standalone audio file.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the music bed because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No audio file was created.

The 15-second instrumental is ready to retry once credits are available: warm Rhodes keys, soft swung drums, rounded bass, and subtle tape texture—with no vocals or spoken words.

approvals.name: generate_music

style.prompt: One standalone 15-second instrumental music bed: warm, relaxed lo-fi hip-hop around 76 BPM. Mellow Rhodes electric piano chords, rounded soft bass, gentle swung dusty kick and snare, delicate muted hi-hats, very subtle vinyl texture and cozy tape warmth. Simple unobtrusive groove, intimate and peaceful, no dramatic changes. Start the groove immediately, keep consistent energy so it can be trimmed to 10 seconds, gentle natural ending. Absolutely no vocals, no spoken words, no vocal samples or humming.
